en: Black‑and‑white harbor scene showing many steamships and smaller boats moored closely together in the foreground, with larger cargo and passenger ships, cranes, and dock facilities across the water. The shoreline and low hills are visible in the background. Printed caption text near the bottom identifies the location, and a publisher's mark is shown in the lower right.
